name: NLL + Entropy Bonus
tagline: Standard GMM NLL with a sample-based entropy regularizer to discourage premature mode collapse.
formula: $$\mathcal{L} = -\,\mathbb{E}_{(s, a^*) \sim \mathcal{D}}\big[\log p_\pi(a^* \mid s)\big] - \alpha \cdot \hat{H}[\pi(\cdot \mid s)] \\ \hat{H} \approx -\,\mathbb{E}_{a \sim \pi}[\log p_\pi(a \mid s)] \quad \text{(sample-based)}, \quad \alpha = 0.01$$
diff_from_baseline: Standard NLL with an explicit sampling-based entropy regularizer (no closed-form for MixtureSameFamily). Encourages broader GMM modes; common variance-collapse mitigation in BC.

name: Weighted NLL
tagline: GMM NLL with positional action dimensions (first 6) up-weighted relative to the gripper dimension (last).
diff_from_baseline: Action-dimension-weighted NLL: implemented by rescaling targets so positional errors contribute more to the log-likelihood, prioritizing accurate end-effector trajectories.

name: Default NLL
tagline: Plain GMM negative log-likelihood — the unedited robomimic BC-GMM training objective.
diff_from_baseline: Robomimic BC-GMM default loss (no edit applied). Standard maximum-likelihood imitation-learning objective for a Gaussian mixture policy; the canonical reference baseline.

name: Mode NLL
tagline: Use only the highest-weight mixture mode's log-probability per sample, not the full marginal mixture.
pseudocode:
1. Per sample: $\ell_k = \log \mathcal{N}(a^* \mid \mu_k(s), \Sigma_k(s))$ for each mode $k$.
2. $k^* = \arg\max_k \,\mathrm{logit}_k(s)$ (highest-weight mode).
3. Loss $= -\frac{1}{B} \sum_i \ell_{k^*}(s_i, a^*_i)$ (no mixture log-sum-exp).
4. Encourages the policy to commit to a single mode per observation.
diff_from_baseline: Project-internal cmd-style baseline (formerly tasks/robomimic-bc-loss/edits/mode_nll.edit.py). Replaces marginal mixture NLL with the argmax-weighted component's NLL; akin to hard-EM, encourages mode commitment over averaging.
